name: filter-token-transfer
title: Filter Token Transfer
description: A two-bucket filter control that makes available and applied criteria explicit.

accessibility.notes: Every token is a named native button with an explicit Add or Remove label. Focus follows the moved token into its new bucket, removed token IDs are pruned when options change, a polite live region reports changes, and empty buckets remain clear.

performance.budget: Local array state only; no observers, global listeners, or continuous animation.
